national_raw_news.title: Haryana CM Nayab Singh Saini says Sweden visit paves way for ₹4,000 crore investment 2 hours ago 41
national_raw_news.content: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini today said that his three-day visit to Sweden has paved the way for an investment of 4,000 crore rupees in the state. He was addressing a press conference in Chandigarh, marking the completion of two years of his government’s third term. Discussing his visit to Sweden, the Chief Minister noted that this investment would generate over 11,000 job opportunities. He explained that the primary objective of the Sweden trip was to attract foreign investment and advanced technology to the state. He added that a previous visit to Singapore had resulted in investment proposals worth 5,500 crore rupees for the state. He further informed that investors and representatives from both countries have been invited to the ‘Happening Haryana’ Global Investors Summit, scheduled for 2027. Reflecting on the achievements of the government on the completion of two years of the BJP government’s third term, he expressed gratitude for the public’s affection and reiterated his commitment to continuous development. He stated that the government has fulfilled 70 promises over the past two years, while work on another 143 promises is progressing rapidly. The Chief Minister also extended his greetings and best wishes to everyone for the upcoming festive season.

national_raw_news.title: Former Punjab BJP president writes to HM Amit Shah, seeking NIA investigation into prison drug operations 2 hours ago 38
national_raw_news.content: Former Punjab BJP president Sunil Jakhar has written to Union Home Minister Amit Shah, seeking investigations by the National Investigation Agency (NIA) into alleged drug operations being run from prisons in Punjab. Mr. Jakhar also demanded a probe by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) into the black money linked to the drug trade in the state. In the letter, Mr. Jakhar, while referring to the recent murder of anti-drug activist Parminder Singh Jhota in Mansa, said that a drug inspector who had served in the same district was arrested two years ago. He mentioned that the DGP had claimed that the said inspector was the kingpin of a gang linked to imprisoned drug traffickers. The network had links to cross-border drug trafficking. Substantial assets worth crores of rupees belonging to him were uncovered. Mr Jakhar said that instead of initiating an NIA investigation or referring the case to the ED, the said drug inspector was reinstated by the Aam Aadmi Party government after his bail. He said that the drug inspector was also appointed to an important position at his department’s headquarters. Mr. Jakhar has called for action against what he described as a drug trade operating from prisons allegedly under state government patronage and for the exposure of the money laundering linked to it.

national_raw_news.content: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment Building a Life of Equality and Dignity The Journey of Maharashtra’s Aniket Adhik Sapkal and Meenakshi Hanumant Patole Posted On: 17 OCT 2026 4:17PM by PIB Delhi For Mr. Aniket Adhik Sapkal and Mrs. Meenakshi Hanumant Patole, their inter-caste marriage represented a commitment to the values of equality, fraternity and social harmony. This was a step towards building a society free from caste-based discrimination. After their marriage, the couple encountered financial and social challenges as they began establishing their new family life. Meeting everyday household expenses, arranging essential necessities and planning for a secure future required financial stability and support. Support through the Inter-Caste Marriage Incentive Scheme At this crucial stage, the Government of Maharashtra’s Inter-Caste Marriage Incentive Scheme, implemented through the Social Welfare Department, provided the couple with valuable financial assistance. The support helped them purchase essential household items, manage daily needs and lay the foundation for a more stable and self-reliant future. The assistance strengthened the couple’s confidence and encouraged them to move forward with greater security and optimism. It enabled them to focus on building their life together while reinforcing their belief in the importance of equality and mutual respect. Promoting Social Harmony and Inclusion The experience of Mr. Aniket Adhik Sapkal and Mrs. Meenakshi Hanumant Patole highlights the role that targeted government assistance can play in supporting couples who choose inter-caste marriage. By extending financial support, the scheme seeks to encourage social integration and contribute to reducing caste-based barriers in society. A New Beginning with Confidence and Dignity Expressing their gratitude, the couple acknowledged the support provided by the Government of Maharashtra and the Social Welfare Department. They expressed hope that more eligible couples would benefit from the scheme and receive support in building secure, dignified and empowered lives. ANI | Updated: 17-10-2026 09:40 IST | Created: 17-10-2026 09:40 IST Air Force Day Aerial Display-2026 (Photo/PIB). Image Credit: ANI Country: India SHARE Key Takeaways AI Summary Analyzing article... Uttar Pradesh's Varanasi will host the Indian Air Force's (IAF) Air Force Day Aerial Display-2026 at Namo Ghat from October 22 to October 25, with fighter aircraft, aerobatic formations and helicopter displays expected to be part of the event. According to the statement by Wing Commander Debartho Dhar, Public Relations Officer and spokesperson for the Ministry of Defence, Prayagraj, the aerial display, titled “Wings Over Ganges”, is being organised as part of celebrations marking the 94th anniversary of the Indian Air Force. The event will showcase the force's flying capabilities against the backdrop of the Ganga and the historic city of Varanasi. The IAF's Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team and Sarang Helicopter Display Team are scheduled to participate in the event, demonstrating aerobatic manoeuvres, precision flying and coordinated formations. The display is expected to feature several aircraft, including the Tejas, Light Combat Helicopter (LCH) Prachand, IL-76, IL-78, C-295 and AN-32, along with frontline fighter aircraft such as the Sukhoi Su-30MKI and Rafale. Aircraft from the Indian Navy and the Indian Army are also scheduled to participate, highlighting joint operational capabilities. The event is also aimed at increasing public awareness about the Indian Air Force and encouraging youth to explore careers in aviation and aerospace technology. It will provide an opportunity for visitors to learn about the training, technology and coordination involved in aerial operations, the statement said. The theme “Wings Over Ganges” brings together the cultural heritage of Varanasi and the operational capabilities of the Indian Air Force, with the Ganga serving as the backdrop for the aerial display. The event is expected to be a key part of the Air Force Day celebrations, offering residents and visitors an opportunity to witness the IAF's aircraft and display teams in action.
